item.description: Sunnyside Games has announced the arrival of a new demo for the upcoming metroidvania Nocturnal 2 for PC and Nintendo Switch.

item.title: Pioneers of Pagonia Review | NoobFeed
item.description: Nusrat from NoobFeed writes: In Pioneers of Patagonia, you dont level up or get stronger by earning experience points as you do in most games. Instead, growth is all over the place. As infrastructure gets better, new materials are found, and production chains grow, your town gets stronger.

item.title: Mario Tennis Fever Overview Trailer and Details, New Joy Con Color Announced
item.description: Nintendo has released a new Overview Trailer and additional details for the upcoming Mario Tennis Fever, set to release on February 12th, 2026. Additionally a new Joy Con color has been revealed.

item.title: Fortnite x South Park: Born in Chaos - Official Collaboration Trailer
item.description: Check out the South Park 'Born in Chaos' Collaboration Trailer for Fortnite, the hit action battle royale game developed by Epic Games. Players can now finally embody Cartman, Kenny, Stan, Kyle, and Butters with their arrival in the Item Shop, alongside attaining free items through progression of the Born in Chaos Pass. Explore Cartmanland and jump into the new Quints 5-person playlist with the South Park Collaboration for Fortnite, launching on February 5.

item.title: Union Asks Judge to Grant Fired GTA 6 Devs Interim Relief, Rockstar Denies Claims
item.description: The Independent Workers Union of Great Britain (IWGB) has asked a judge to grant the fired GTA 6 developers interim relief at a preliminary employment tribunal hearing held in the UK this week. Rockstar Games, which also attended the hearing, has issued a response to the claims, denying a number of points made by the union.
